policy: Finite conditional ownEG classification only; preserve original definitions/results and SG/AG constraints. Missing or unqualified selection requires UNKNOWN. One explicitly declared absolute ping installation refines a literal secret destination from UNKNOWN to FORBIDDEN. Prerequisites are independent of guard verdicts.

priorityNotes.dependent: Local readers and shell substitutions do not by themselves establish a separate outbound sink. Missing or unqualified selected sender/launcher cannot be classified as that canonical executable.
priorityNotes.directGitHelpers: The three literal git-send-email/git-imap-send commands select direct PATH executables. Namespace-derived Git operation metadata is not a separate executed sender.
priorityNotes.watch: The generated ordinary printf source depends on the selected watch wrapper; a missing wrapper is not proof that it executed the source.
priorityNotes.R13P035: The independent SG literal-secret staging FORBIDDEN must remain. Only EG classification changes; overall decision stays deny.
priorityNotes.execClean: An unqualified selection stage, not proof that exec-c looks up with empty PATH. Known Bash 5.2 source order does not qualify every outer backend or this stage in the guard.
priorityNotes.queries: Even terminal help/query/error executes the selected external wrapper. Unavailable wrapper is UNKNOWN; a present program retains the original role assertion. Later child DATA is not independent executed code.
priorityNotes.watchSource: The four watch sources and one chrt shell operand depend on their selected outer wrapper. This does not suppress an independent statement or outer expansion sink.
priorityNotes.absolutePing: R39PING-ABSOLUTE-CLIENT retains its original UNKNOWN oracle. The explicit profile separately requires FORBIDDEN only when /sbin/ping is a present canonical known installation and can select its literal secret-derived destination. No native resolver or transmission claim.
priorityNotes.caffeinate: Four original dependent-child or terminal-query inputs keep their original semantic expectation whenever caffeinate is present. Only independent absence in the actual unchanged PATH enables UNKNOWN; no platform-name assumption or blanket skip.
